[ 02 / 04 ] · About

From data to agents

AI Engineer in Toronto. I turn messy, real-world data into LLM applications and agents that can be tested, audited and trusted.

I'm an AI Engineer at Environics Analytics, building LLM-powered applications that combine models, data and cloud infrastructure: agent-facing tool servers, secured remote access, review workflows with humans in the loop, and the evaluations that decide whether any of it ships.

Before that I spent two years as a Research Associate in machine learning — building production data pipelines, automated quality control and XGBoost models over foot-traffic, GPS, demographic and mapping data, and investigating anomalies down to their root cause.

I hold an MSc in Computer Science from Ontario Tech University, where my thesis introduced trend dependencies: approximate, learned constraints over noisy time series. Outside of work, I play piano.

#01 · Agents

Agents & tool interfaces

#02 · Evaluation

Evaluation & guardrails

Benchmarks with baselines, paired comparisons and stated limits. Grounding and citation checks, prompt-injection test suites, random audits and human review queues — so a model's output is accepted on evidence, not fluency.
